message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2) in Europeans**

| Source | Minor allele (C) frequency |
|--------|----------------------------|
| gnomAD v2.1 (European subset) | **≈ 0.10–0.12** |
| 1000 Genomes Project (EUR panel) | **≈ 0.09–0.11** |

> **Interpretation**  
> The C allele at rs7412 corresponds to the APOE ε2 allele. In most European populations it occurs in roughly 10 % of chromosomes (i.e., about 1 in 10 alleles). This frequency is fairly stable across continental European subgroups but can vary slightly (e.g., 8–13 % in specific cohorts).

> **Key points**  
> * The frequency is reported as the proportion of chromosomes carrying the minor allele (C).  
> * It is derived from large reference datasets such as gnomAD and the 1000 Genomes Project.  
> * Frequencies may differ in isolated or admixed populations; always check the specific cohort if you need precise numbers.

**Reference**  
* gnomAD Browser – European (non-Finnish) allele counts for rs7412.  
* 1000 Genomes Project – EUR panel allele frequencies.
